title: For events of type 'Meeting' that have a remaining budget greater than $30,
question: For events of type 'Meeting' that have a remaining budget greater than $30, find the expense descriptions associated with the budget line that has the lowest remaining amount among all such events.

prediction.sql:
SELECT e.XCL_018
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b ON ev.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
JOIN expense e ON b.XCL_003 = e.XCL_023
WHERE ev.XCL_013 = 'Meeting'
  AND b.XCL_006 > 30
  AND b.XCL_006 = (
    SELECT MIN(b2.XCL_006)
    FROM event ev2
    JOIN budget b2 ON ev2.XCL_010 = b2.XCL_009
    WHERE ev2.XCL_013 = 'Meeting'
      AND b2.XCL_006 > 30
  )
